_help: Talking manual FRESH question set, Greek (step AM6, W123 / W128): written on 2026-11-08 AFTER every tuning choice (the search factors, index.SAID, the extract floor, the prompt) from MANUAL_EL.txt + the tour, by Claude, in an operator's words - topics and phrasings that are NOT in questions_el.json. Measured ONCE end to end (tools/assistant_llm_eval.py run --set fresh --answer extract) and NEVER tuned on: a change to the search / floor / prompt made after that measurement makes these numbers stale (then a new fresh set is needed). Same format as questions_el.json: expect = phrases of the manual (any one; accents / case / line breaks ignored), [] = NOT in the manual (the right answer is 'Δεν βρίσκω απάντηση στο εγχειρίδιο.'), must = the term an answer must mention, gap = the manual is thin here. Label repairs (an expected phrase that is not in any passage text) would have been allowed after the retrieval check - none were needed (0 BROKEN); nothing was changed after it.
